Draft 2.0 begins: each draft is its own file with room for versions, and your existing writing moves over automatically.
An inbox shows every draft with its stage, versions, and last edit. Press ⌘N for a new draft.
Titles come from your first sentence, or from your AI once there is enough to go on.
Undo and redo stay with each draft, even after restarting.
Alternate wording, set aside, overflow, and the Lab have been removed.
